title: Sessions offer to swap themselves for a fresh one on the next goal, and do it on the user's yes

fields.why: TJ asked for it; this session is long and its own work is done

text: Build requirements F1-F5 in app/DESIGN.md, section 'Swapping in a fresh session'. Reuse the Assistant's version: cmdClearContext in lib/overview.mjs writes clear-context.json to the channel; AppModel.clearAssistantIfAsked swaps the session. Generalise both to every session, keyed to a goal, refusing on checkpoint gaps, requiring --user-said. Recently ended (AppModel.confirmEnd/reopen) must keep the old conversation. Agent instructions in agent/*.md. Do not touch InspectorView, DashboardView, Snapshot.swift, SessionStrip.swift (another session holds them). Restart the app only with open -g.

Also build F7 (follow-up work per session) from app/DESIGN.md: CLI/snapshot side first. Panel display needs InspectorView/Snapshot.swift, held by the session-only-panel session: ask it before touching them.

fields.user_said: and yes, you can start thew session swap feature work tooo

text: genlock swap GOAL --user-said '..' refuses without --user-said, and refuses while checkpoint has gaps, naming each gap; nothing is written to the channel when it refuses

Inside the app, a successful swap records a checkpoint and the user's words, and writes swap.json (goal id, title, opening message 'genlock continue GOAL') to the session's channel; outside the app it writes nothing and tells the user to /clear and say 'continue <goal>'

The app replaces any non-Assistant session that asked to swap, once its turn has ended, with a fresh conversation in the same tab position whose first message continues the named goal; the old conversation goes to Recently ended
check: swift test in app/ for the swap decision logic, and drive: a session that runs genlock swap is replaced and the old one appears under Recently ended

text: Agent instructions (agent/continuity.md and the installed block) tell agents to offer the swap in one short message at every natural finish: what was finished, open follow-ups, the next goal, yes/no; and to run genlock swap only on the user's yes

genlock followups lists what THIS session identified and has not finished: goals it added/proposed still open, tickets it opened still open, spin-offs it proposed (with launch-safety) or launched and still open, its unanswered questions to the user, and unproved requirements on its tickets; snapshot exposes the same per session

evidence: tests/run.mjs swap section: no --user-said -> exit 1 'user's yes', no swap.json; missing latest -> exit 3 naming the ticket, no swap.json; unknown goal refused; 407/407 pass

tests/run.mjs: in-app swap writes swap.json {goal, prompt containing 'genlock continue G', user_said}, project.jsonl gets checkpoint + swap{user_said}; without GENLOCK_APP_CHANNEL no swap.json, prints 'run /clear, then say "continue refunds"' (checkpoint is still recorded)

tests/run.mjs followups section: lists added+proposed goals, own ticket not other's, proposed spinoff safe=true and not duplicated as task, unanswered user question (gone once answered), unproved reqs; snapshot.followups has both sessions. Real repo: d40e5fac shows G-EEVA6, T-WQXVG, 2 launched spinoffs

text: CLI done: genlock swap + followups (lib/followups.mjs, continuity.mjs cmdSwap, snapshot.followups), tests 407/407. Next: app side (VoiceChannel.requestedSwap, AppModel.swapIfAsked), agent/continuity.md instructions.

evidence: Driven debug app, isolated store + fake claude (scratchpad/drive): r2 after genlock swap but mid-turn -> unchanged; after state done r3 -> visible [swapdemo] same tab, conversation c49294c9->a501bd8d, fake claude args start 'Carry on with the goal ... genlock continue G-ANGHQ', message 'Started a fresh session...'; sessions.json ended=[{conversation c49294c9, slot 352fa6}]. SwapTests 6/6.

agent/continuity.md: two bullets (offer at natural finish via genlock followups: finished/open/next goal/yes-no; swap only on yes with --user-said); copied into skills/continuity, .claude/skills/continuity, AGENTS.md (grep 'genlock swap' = 2 each); in-app SessionLaunch.swapRule added with spinoffRule, SwapTests checks project gets it, Assistant does not
node tests/run.mjs -> 407 passed 0 failed; swift test -> 103 tests, 0 failures (incl. CoreTests testSessionsReportTheirStateWithSpeechOff, kept passing by attaching swapRule only with spinoffRule)

answers.observed: test counts 407/0 and 103/0; drive reports r1-r3 and sessions.json in scratchpad/drive
answers.cause: none claimed; refusals traced to checkpointGaps
answers.absence: reopen of the swapped-out main session was not driven: the reopen step matches project id only; relies on existing slot-resume path (memory.conversations[key] -> transcripts.start)
answers.assumption: swap waits for phase done + no replies + not dictating, same as Assistant clear; my choice. Outside app, swap still records a checkpoint (user said yes)
answers.falsify: a drive that reopens the ended slot and finds a new conversation id instead of c49294c9

what: Reopening a swapped-out main session from Recently ended was not driven
verify: Swap a main session, click it in Recently ended, check the conversation id matches the ended entry
